name: Delaware DIAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Felton, DE · Killens Pond State Park
headline: Delaware DIAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: St. Andrews’ Henry Bird ran the fastest time of the day, 15:11.90, to win the Division 2 boys race, and Salesianum’s James Dempsey won Division 1 in 15:49.90. Padua’s Paige Ballinger won the Division 1 girls race in 18:10.60, and Tatnall’s Lauryn Leech won Division 2 in 18:14.80.
